title: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) vs Minimum Viable Replacement (MVR) - Understanding the Difference | HatchWorks AI
description: There's a better way to build software than the Minimal Viable Product (MVP) approach, the Minimal Viable Replacement (MVR). MVR is ideal for when you're not building a new solution but modernizing or replacing an existing one.
